assign.card: In flight: the 3-5 tasks being worked on now, and what's next

decision.question: review size
decision.why: small new view, three files plus tests; shots already read

findings.text: No shots exist in the task folder (only requirements.md, past-work.md, session.jsonl, inbox.jsonl, review/diff.patch), yet ask 5 requires 360×740 and 1920 shots of this session showing the plugin build, the single voice assistant, the ProcessRunner fix and the `session.sessions` rename. session.jsonl records "review size: light, shots already read", but no shot file is there to read; the phone-first claim is unproven.

None of the five "owner's asks" boxes in requirements.md are ticked, and no commit, test run or shot is recorded as proof. A fresh agent cannot tell what was verified; the unit test (InFlight.test.mjs) has no recorded pass.

Nothing shows the AI dashboard part works: AIDashboard.js:33-39 asks `new QueryClient("inflight", …)` with `where state eq active` and `sort last_activity`, and I could not confirm the `inflight` source returns `state`, `last_activity` or a `url` per row (Servex/agents/Sessions.js only mentions the name). If `url` is missing the whole block silently renders nothing (`if (res.error || !res.rows?.length) return;`), so a failure looks like "no sessions in flight".

AISessionDetail.js:47-50 dropped the SessionStats comment half-way: the "Figma band E: stats first, sticky" note now sits on the `$inflight` line, and the `$inflight` div is not inside the sticky stats band. Move the comment back to `new SessionStats(...)` and check the block doesn't scroll away or fight the sticky stats on 360 px.

The "Done today" ask is built as a total `done` count of every completed task (InFlight.js:103), not today's, and is hidden on the all-sessions view (InFlightView.js:180). In this session with hundreds of tasks it would say "300 done". Filter by completion date today, or rename the line, and note the choice in doc/in-flight.md.

The ask shows "Next: idle or queued tasks" on `/framework/ai/` too ("the same component"), but InFlightView.js:179 hides Next when `all` is set, and a session with only Next tasks is dropped. The doc (in-flight.md) does not say the dashboard omits Next; either show it or document the difference.

Indexing: `core/Session/doc/in-flight.md` is linked from core/Session/readme.md, but the files table in the doc lacks no entry for the new `Session` module line in `public/framework/readme.md`'s index or `ai/readme.md` (which describes `now/` as the in-flight page and AIDashboard without mentioning the new block), and ext/Query/readme.md was not updated with the new `inflight` caller. Add one line each so `/framework/ai/` readme reflects that the dashboard now starts with this view.

InFlightView opens one `SessionTasks(...).live()` reader per session (up to 8 on the dashboard) and never closes them; fine for a page view, but the readers survive if the view is removed. Worth a `.stop()` on teardown if View has a hook.

Simplicity: `InFlight.pick` and the view are small and reuse `SessionTasks`/`Session.replay`, which is good; but the rows are a new row layout (`if-row`) rather than reusing `core/Task/TaskView.js`, which the brief said to reuse ("Reuse the row; don't build a new task card"). The doc claims "Not a new task card", which is arguable; say why TaskView was not reused.

InFlight.css hard-codes `grid-template-columns: 1fr 5rem 2.5rem` and `max-width: 40rem` with rem sizes; at 1920 the block stays 40rem wide with empty space, and the `#2a8` fallback bypasses the theme accent. Check against the css questions once shots exist.

decision.question: review size
decision.why: re-review after fixing the first review's findings; small view

findings.text: No ask in requirements.md is ticked (0 `[x]` lines under "The owner's asks"), and nothing in the task folder records the unit test passing; the code is in a worktree, so `node public/framework/core/Session/InFlight.test.mjs` does not exist in the main tree and I could not run it. Tick each ask with its proof (shot name or test output) so a fresh agent can see what was verified.

Ask 3 ("across sessions at /framework/ai/") has no shot: the folder holds only shot-session-1920.png and shot-session-360.png (the session page). Add a 360 and a 1920 shot of /framework/ai/ showing the block, since that block is a separate code path (AIDashboard.js:33-39) with a silent `return` when the query fails or has no `url`.

ai/AIDashboard/readme.md ("Where each section reads from" table, around line 30) does not list the new in-flight block, though the code now adds a section with its own `inflight` QueryClient. CLAUDE.md law 9 says the readme must state each section's source, so add a row.

ai/readme.md line 61 (the dashboard bullet) now reads badly: the new sentence is followed by a dangling parenthetical "(the default page at `/framework/ai/` since 2026-10-19, merge …: sessions by origin…" that no longer attaches to anything. Rewrite it as one clear sentence.

AIDashboard.js:18 comment says "active in the last hour" but the query (line 20) is `state = active`, sorted by `last_activity`, `limit: 8`, with no one-hour filter; AINow filters at one hour (AINow.js:52). Either apply the same cutoff or fix the comment; as written, eight active-but-idle sessions can crowd out one with real work in flight.

Law 6 (one of everything): AIDashboard asks a second `inflight` query that AINow (`ai/now/AINow.js:40`) already asks and holds live. Reusing AINow's rows would save a request and keep the two in step; the doc (in-flight.md, "Choices") says it is the same query, so this is a known choice.

The shots show the session has 36 tasks in the `running` state ("+ 31 more running", shot-session-1920.png), and the picked five include "Make automated testing…" at 0% with no now line. The "3 to 5 major ones" the owner wants is therefore decided purely by recency; it does not show the ProcessRunner fix or the `session.sessions` rename that requirements.md names. Not a code bug, but the ask 1 outcome is only partly met on the real session.

"Done today" in the ask became a count of all completed tasks (in-flight.md, "Choices"), and on /framework/ai/ both Next and Done are dropped. The owner's "what's queued next" (ask 2) is therefore visible only on a session page, not across sessions.

Waiting rows draw a progress bar and "0%" (shot-session-1920.png, "Get this session to 100%…", 0%), which is noise for a row that only needs the one thing asked. Titles are `nowrap` and cut at 360 ("Voice Chat: one single voi…", shot-session-360.png), so on a phone the title is barely readable; consider letting the title wrap.
The 1920 shot ends at the Waiting section, so a "Next" section is not visible in either shot; it is unproven that Next renders on a live session.

requirements.md asks for "Done today: a count, collapsed"; InFlightView.js:204 shows "N done" for every completed task ever, not today's, and it is not collapsed. doc/in-flight.md admits this; either filter by completion date or state in requirements.md that the owner's ask was changed.

The 1920 shot (shot-session-1920.png) still draws a progress bar and percent on the "Waiting on you" rows (dictation-v3 23%), yet InFlightView.js:213-218 draws none (`bare`) and review.jsonl answer 9 says "fixed". The shot predates the fix, so the proof does not match the code; re-shoot it.

Ask 5 wants the shots to show the plugin build, the single voice assistant, the ProcessRunner fix and the `session.sessions` rename waiting. shot-session-360.png ends at the "Waiting on you" heading, and neither shot shows the ProcessRunner fix or that rename; the walkthrough is incomplete.

Ask 3 (across sessions at /framework/ai/) has no proof: AIDashboard.js:33-38 returns silently if the `inflight` query errors or lacks `url` per row, so a failure looks like "nothing in flight". Confirm the query's row fields (`url`, `state`, `last_activity`) and shoot it after merge, or the [~] stays open.

The AISessionDetail.js:261-262 block (`$inflight`) sits between the sticky stats band and the tabs, with a comment that says "on every tab". Check on 360 that it doesn't scroll behind or fight the sticky stats, since the owner asked for phone first. The shot only shows the top of the page.

36 tasks are running in the session, so the 5 "major" tasks are picked only by `_last_ts` recency (InFlight.js:121). The owner said a session has hundreds of tasks and wanted the major ones; the pick shows "Make automated testing… 0%" as a major task. Rank by priority or a depth rule, or write the limit into requirements.md, not only review.jsonl.

Across sessions (`all: true`) the view leaves out Next and Done (InFlightView.js:203-204), so a session with only queued work is not listed at /framework/ai/. That departs from the mockup; it is documented in doc/in-flight.md, which is enough.

Simpler path: AIDashboard.js:19-23 runs a second `inflight` query that AINow.js already asks, and opens up to 8 live tails. It could share AINow's rows; the doc names this as a choice, so it is only a note.

Indexing is fine: core/Session/readme.md, ai/readme.md, AIDashboard/readme.md and doc/in-flight.md link the new files, including InFlight.test.mjs, and the stale AI dashboard line was updated. Nothing is unindexed.
A fresh agent can continue from the task folder only partly: requirements.md ticks are marked, but there is no recorded test run for InFlight.test.mjs and no report of what is left (items 1-6).

The walkthrough does not show "waiting" or "next": both shots (shot-session-1920.png, shot-session-360.png) cut off at the "Waiting on you" heading, so the requirements' proof of the `session.sessions` rename and the ProcessRunner fix is missing; retake them taller, or scroll to the block.

"Done today: a count, collapsed" is not met: InFlightView.js:205 prints "N done" for every completed task ever, not today's, and it is not collapsed (no `12 ▸`). The doc admits the first half (doc/in-flight.md, Choices); the collapsed form is not mentioned and the requirement is ticked anyway.

The "show it first, at the top" ask is only half met: in shot-session-1920.png the block sits below the title and the stats card (AISessionDetail.js:261-262 inserts it after SessionStats), so at 1920 the in-flight list starts about 400px down and at 360 it sits below the stats row. Move it above the stats or say why not.

Requirement 3 is ticked `[~]` but unshot, and the AIDashboard path is the riskiest part: AIDashboard.js:34 fires a second "inflight" query with stub `row`/`stale` callbacks, so the block never refreshes when sessions change (the session list is read once, though each session's tasks stay live), and it silently draws nothing on any error (line 21). Add a shot of /framework/ai/ after merge, or a line in AIDashboard/readme.md saying the list is read once.

"In flight" is not a trustworthy list: the shot shows "+ 31 more running" and rows at 0% (e.g. "The session detail view should be the home for all…"), so tasks that are only `running` by state flood the top 5. The owner asked for the 3–5 major tasks. Check what marks a task as running, or rank by recent activity (`_last_ts`) before `completion`; InFlight.js:121 ranks on "has a now line or progress" first, which a stale task can have.

The diff carries noise that is not this task's: `files.jsonl` changes in core/Session/tasks/data-shapes/** and tasks/files.jsonl, plus a `readme.md.tmp.51972…` entry in core/Session/files.jsonl:34-35. Commit by path (the requirements' fence) and leave the auto-written index lines of other tasks out.

The unit test runs as the owner asked (InFlight.test.mjs, 9 checks per the task log), but it is only in the worktree, so I could not re-run it from the main tree; the tests of pick() cover `waiting_on` filtering and the cap of 5 but not the `paused` or Prompt exclusion.
The row is a new small row, not `core/Task/TaskView.js` as the requirements told it to reuse; doc/in-flight.md gives the reason ("would have meant hiding most of it"), which is reasonable.

Indexing is good: doc/in-flight.md is linked from core/Session/readme.md and listed in doc/files.jsonl, AIDashboard/readme.md has a new table row, and ai/readme.md names the block. A fresh agent could continue from the task folder (requirements.md, review.jsonl, past-work.md); the one thing missing is a short result line in requirements.md saying which of items 1-5 above are still open.

Requirement 5 asks for shots showing "waiting" items, but shot-session-1920.png and shot-session-360.png both cut off at the "Waiting on you" heading (one row, "dictation-v3", visible; no what-is-needed line), and Next and Done are never shown; re-shoot taller (or full page) so the whole block is proven, and say in requirements.md which in-flight tasks (plugin build, voice assistant, ProcessRunner fix) are in the picture.

Ask 5 (the block at the top of /framework/ai/, AIDashboard.js:33-39) is ticked `[~]` and has no shot or run at all; the `r.url` + `session.jsonl` URL building and the 20 s query are untested, so either shoot it against the running site or record in the task folder exactly how it was checked.

The owner asked for "Done today: a count, collapsed"; what ships is an all-time "N done" line, not collapsed (InFlightView.js:205, doc/in-flight.md "Choices"). The reason is documented, but the owner's wording is not met; at least group by the completion timestamp if one exists, or say plainly in requirements.md that this ask is partly unmet.

A fresh agent cannot continue from the task folder alone: it holds task.jsonl review answers and a computed past-work.md, but no short summary of what was built, where, and what is left (the unshot dashboard view, Done-today). Add a few lines to requirements.md or a small notes file.

AIDashboard.js:34 leaves an empty `.ad-sec.ad-inflight` box in place when the query errors or returns no rows (the box is created before `in_flight`, and the method returns early), which may add a gap above the grid; create the box only when there is something to show.
The session page now runs two live readers of the same session.jsonl: InFlightView (AISessionDetail.js:264) and the Tasks tab's SessionTasks (line 337); one shared replay would honour law 6.

At 360 (shot-session-360.png, "In flight" band) the bar and percent columns (7.5rem) leave titles about half the width, so most titles end in an ellipsis; stacking the bar under the title on phones would read better.
core/Session/files.jsonl:287-288 now records a stray `readme.md.tmp.51972…` file (a tool artefact); harmless, generated.
